title: Fabrication of a tunable mesoporous polypyrrole/MXene composite with a sandwich structure for enhancing electromagnetic wave absorption performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10298-10309
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00972C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenjuan Zhang, Xiangyue Yang, Youliang Wang, Yaxian Wang, Xuyang Wu, Yongqian Shen
A mesoporous polypyrrole/MXene (mPM) composite with multi-layer sandwich-like structures was developed via molecular self-assembly templated by block copolymer micelles, enhancing dielectric loss for superior electromagnetic wave absorption.
